w19d1.ref:
def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):
    p = k / n; d = 1 + z * z / n
    c = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d
    m = z * ((p * (1 - p) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) ** 0.5) / d
    return c - m, c + m
print(wilson(18, 20))   # about (0.70, 0.97): 18/20 is not exactly 90%
w19d1.check: Interval must widen when n is small.
